confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking sites. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary by district and season, and July demand may push them higher. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.7x beer, wine about 2x) because direct knowledge of Taipei bar pricing is weaker. Local prices converted at roughly NT$30-32 per USD from general knowledge. The FX value comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the full RBA table was not directly retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Regional basis: East Asian metros such as Seoul, Osaka and Hong Kong, with Taipei's dining and drink prices generally below Hong Kong and Seoul.
